sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Commencing Alpha Route; check-in at the corner of Victoria Street East and Queen Street, all clear.
Welfare check at Starbucks Queen Street, Lotus Foreign Exchange, Nike, Cotton On, Habits Vietnamese Cafe and Eatery and Localito Convenience Store, all clear.
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street and Ms Higgins, all clear.
Check-in at Skyworld Entertainment Centre, all clear.
Check-in at Aotea Square; full sweep completed within the area, welfare check at Jack's Fried Chicken and Aotea Centre, all clear. Standing by to show presence while awaiting further response calls.
Welfare check at Elliott Street Apartment and Atrium on Elliott, making our way up towards Crowne Plaza Hotel, all clear.
Welfare check at City Convenience Store, all clear.
Welfare check at Sky Mart Convenience Store, Formery, Sergeant Coffee, Little Albert's Coffee and The People's Barista, all clear.
Check-in at the top of Victoria Street; welfare checks commenced, scoping the area for any issues, all clear. Standing by to ensure a strong security presence while awaiting further response calls.
Continuing patrols; no activities requiring our assistance. Patrolling down Federal Street scoping for any vagrants.
Welfare check completed around The Cathedral Church and Federal Square; a few street vagrants visible but no concerns identified.
Welfare check at Albert Mart Convenience Store and Discount Dairy, all clear.
Check-in at the corner of Customs and Albert Street intersection, all clear.
Welfare check at Metro Woolworths and Aotea Gifts, all clear.
Welfare check at OK Gift Shop, all clear.
Arrived at Queens Wharf; welfare checks commenced on stores within the area and the wharf docks, all clear.

Check-in at Commercial Bay; full walkthrough completed around the location with welfare checks on all stores, all clear. Stopped and chatted with the static guards, all clear. Standing by to ensure a strong security presence before moving along.
Commencing Delta Route. Check-in at Kiwi Bank; no issues reported by the static guard, checked in on stores within the area as well, all clear.
Follow-up check at Giapo regarding the suspicious individual from yesterday, all clear. Welfare checks commenced on all stores within the area.
Check-in at the bottom of Fort Street, all clear. Standing by to ensure a strong security presence.
Check-in at Wilson Carpark, Fort Street; area thoroughly scoped. Welfare check, all clear:
Commencing welfare checks along Lower High Street and O'Connell Lane, all clear.
Arrived at Freyberg Place and Women's Memorial Hall; no issues found, heavy presence from members of the public, all clear.
Check-in at Chancery Square; full sweep completed within the vicinity, no issues found, checked in on stores, all clear. Standing by to show presence while awaiting further response calls.
Continuing patrols; welfare checks on all stores along Upper High Street, all clear.
Commencing welfare checks on Lorne Street stores and businesses, all clear. Water fountain clear of any street vagrant encampment.
Check-in at the corner of Lorne and Wellesley Street, all clear.

Welfare check with the female static guard at Auckland Library, all clear. Heavier street vagrant encampment presence at the corner of the Library and along Rutland Street near Uni Lodge; no trouble occurring, but not a pleasant look for the public space.
Welfare check at Nandos, Munster Inn and Queens Food Court, all clear.
Check-in at the top of Mayoral Drive; area thoroughly scoped, no issues found. Ending Delta Route.

Check-in at Aotea Square; heavy presence building from members of the public bringing their families out to enjoy the activities provided at the square. Standing by to ensure a strong security presence.
Response call from The Cathedral Church reporting a male street vagrant sleeping next to the church; the Pastor requested assistance to move him along.
Arrived at the response location; woke the male individual sleeping in front of the door entrance and asked him to move along. He complied without further issues.
Response call from Auckland Council Wardens reporting a group of street vagrants congregating at Darby Street consuming alcohol.

Arrived at the response location on Darby Street; the group of street vagrants was congregating in front of a vacated store, but no alcohol was seen or being consumed. Patrolling through Queen Street ensuring our presence is visible.
Check-in at Woolworths and Chemist Warehouse Victoria Street, all clear.
Standing by at Elliott Street ensuring a strong security presence while awaiting further response calls.

Response call from McDonald's Queen Street reporting that a female individual who caused issues previously is back in the store; assistance requested to remove her from the premises. Staff then spoke with her and noted she had already placed an order.
Arrived at the response location; the store manager asked us to stand by for the time being and await further updates.
Continuing patrols; the individual walked out without causing any further issues for staff or the store.
Arrived at the bottom of HQ; standing by to ensure a strong security presence before heading up to the office for break.
Arrived at the office; taking lunch break.

Response call from 147 Quay Street regarding a young female in her early 20s who appeared to be going through personal issues; members of the public had stopped her for a chat and she had been crying for the past 25 minutes. Immediate attention requested in case of a possible suicide attempt.
Arrived at the response location; scoped the area for the female individual but was unable to find her. Making our way back to HQ for changeover.
Morning shift completed; equipment handed over.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 2 x Radios, 2 x Body Cameras, 1 x Swipe Key.
Remained on standby at HQ while charging the Ops Phone due to low battery; patrols to commence once sufficient charge available.

While maintaining a security presence along Queen Street, encountered a male vagrant who began recording security personnel and making allegations about someone breaking into his house, questioning security staff about the alleged incident. He was instructed to move along but continued recording; security disengaged and resumed patrols and business welfare checks along Queen Street.

Observed a male vagrant outside Ippondo on Queen Street; approached and instructed him to move away from the storefront due to repeated complaints from the store manager. Remained on standby to ensure compliance.
The individual outside Ippondo complied and moved away from the storefront; no further issues reported. Resumed patrols.

Arrived at the bottom of Wyndham Street; welfare checks on businesses along Queen Street between HQ and Wyndham Street, all clear. Maintained a visible security presence and stood by for nearby response calls while monitoring for problematic individuals.
Departed standby area; no incidents or response calls occurred.
Arrived at the bottom of Vulcan Lane; welfare checks on surrounding businesses, all clear with no concerns reported.
Arrived at Fort Street / Jean Batten Street; welfare checks completed on businesses within the area and along Queen Street between Pocket Park and Vulcan Lane, all clear.
Maintained security presence on Fort Street while monitoring for problematic individuals, vagrants and other disturbances (15:53–16:12).
Departed standby area; no incidents occurred.
Arrived at Gore Street; welfare checks on surrounding businesses, all clear.

Arrived at TK Square; welfare checks on businesses within the square and along Customs Street East between TK Square and Gore Street, no concerns reported. Maintained a visible security presence for businesses and members of the public.
Departed standby area; no incidents or problematic individuals observed.

Arrived at Albert Mart, where the shopkeeper reported that four teenagers had entered the store and demanded vaping products without payment, claiming they were old enough to obtain them. The teenagers remained outside the premises; at the shopkeeper's request security approached the group and instructed them to move along. All four complied without incident. Remained on standby.

Arrived at St Patrick's Square and observed a male throwing traffic cones around outside Liston House. Conducted a welfare check and instructed the individual to move along to prevent further disturbance or complaints from building management; he complied without incident. Remained on standby in case he returned.
Departed standby area; the previously observed individual was no longer present. No further issues reported.
Arrived at the top of Victoria Street West; welfare checks on surrounding businesses, all clear. Maintained security presence while monitoring for problematic individuals and vagrants.
Departed standby area; no incidents or problematic individuals observed.
Arrived at Mayoral Drive; welfare checks on businesses within the area, all clear.
Arrived at Aotea Square; welfare checks on surrounding businesses, all clear. Maintained a visible security presence for members of the public.
Departed standby area and returned towards HQ to conduct floor checks, continuing welfare checks on businesses along the route.
Arrived at HQ; welfare checks on businesses between Aotea Square and HQ completed, all clear.
Floor checks completed; remained on standby at HQ while charging the Ops Phone due to low battery.
Ops Phone battery reached 30%; preparing to resume patrols.

Commenced patrols. Received a response call from Moona Store in MidCity regarding a male vagrant who had entered the premises and allegedly made racially abusive comments towards staff; responded immediately.
Arrived at Moona Store; the individual had already left the premises. Remained on standby in case he returned.

Received a response call from Movenpick Hotel regarding a male who had allegedly stolen a set of headphones from the premises. Hotel staff used the headphones' tracking feature to identify their last known location near Wyndham Street and Queen Street; security commenced searching for the person of interest.
Located and made contact with a Movenpick Hotel staff member who was following the suspected individual; continued assisting with the search.
The male POI was located at Chancery Square and the stolen headphones were successfully recovered.

While dealing with the Movenpick Hotel incident, encountered the same male POI previously involved in the Moona Store incident; advised him not to return to Moona Store. The individual apologised and remained in the area; security maintained observation.

Received a response call from W Cosmetics on Queen Street regarding the same male POI from the earlier Moona Store incident, who had entered their premises. While speaking with staff, security was advised the individual had already left and was heading up Queen Street.

Located the male POI outside Foot Locker; searched him for suspected stolen merchandise, but no stolen items were found. The individual was advised not to return to W Cosmetics; he complied and moved along without incident, last seen heading towards Darby Street. Security remained on standby along Queen Street.
Departed standby area and resumed patrols.
Arrived at TK Square; welfare check at McDonald's Britomart, all clear. Maintained security presence while monitoring for problematic individuals and vagrants.
Departed standby area; no incidents occurred.
Arrived at Fort Street; welfare checks on surrounding businesses, all clear.
Arrived at Chancery Square / Freyberg Square; welfare checks on businesses within the area, all clear. Maintained a visible security presence.
Departed standby area; no incidents or problematic individuals observed.
Arrived at the corner of High Street and Victoria Street East; no issues reported.
Arrived at the corner of Queen Street and Victoria Street West; maintained security presence.
Departed standby area; no incidents or problematic individuals observed. Continued patrol towards the top of Victoria Street West.
Arrived at the top of Victoria Street West; welfare checks on surrounding businesses, all clear. Maintained security presence.
Departed standby area; no incidents occurred. Returned towards HQ for break.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received (deployed 22:49): 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone, 2 x Body Cameras, 2 x Radios.
Remained at HQ charging the Ops Phone, as the battery was at 3%.
Night shift personnel prepared to commence patrols.
Departed HQ and commenced patrols; Ops Phone battery had reached 42%.

Welfare checks at McDonald's Queen Street and 77 Convenience Store on Queen Street; large groups of customers present inside McDonald's but staff reported no issues. Commenced a full patrol sweep of Upper Queen Street.
Completed patrol of Upper Queen Street; all clear, no issues reported.
Arrived at Aotea Square and commenced a full security sweep of the area.
Completed a full sweep of Aotea Square; all clear, no issues observed. Remained on standby for nearby response calls.
Departed Aotea Square and continued patrols towards Mayoral Drive and Wellesley Street.
Completed patrols along Mayoral Drive and Wellesley Street West; all clear, no issues reported.

Welfare check at 77 Convenience Store; a vagrant observed outside the premises. Maintained a visible security presence along Victoria Street due to a busy function taking place at The Fiddler Irish Bar.
Completed welfare checks at 77 Convenience Store and The Fiddler Irish Bar; both locations clear with no issues reported. Continued patrols towards Federal Street.
Completed patrol of Federal Street; all clear, no issues reported.
Conducted a security check around St Patrick's Cathedral; all clear, no issues reported.
Maintained a visible security presence outside Ace Karaoke while monitoring the surrounding area.
Ace Karaoke commenced closing procedures; all clear with no incidents reported. Continued patrols towards Albert Street.
Completed patrol of Albert Street; all clear, no issues reported.
Welfare checks at AAS and Provedor; no issues reported.
Completed a full security sweep of Quay Street; all clear with no incidents observed.
Arrived at Commercial Bay and commenced a full patrol sweep of the area.
Completed patrols throughout Commercial Bay; all clear. Also conducted a welfare check at McDonald's Britomart, where staff reported no concerns.
Conducted a security check along Gore Street; all clear, no issues observed.

Completed a full security sweep of Fort Street, Wilson Carpark, Fort Lane and Imperial Lane; welfare check at Jo & Joe's. All areas clear with no concerns reported. Remained on standby at Imperial Lane for nearby response calls.
Departed Imperial Lane and continued foot patrols towards High Street.
Completed patrol of High Street; all clear, no issues reported.
Conducted a full security sweep of Freyberg Square and Chancery Square; both locations clear with no issues observed. Remained on standby at Chancery Square for nearby response calls.
Chancery Square remained clear with no response calls received. Observed a few vagrants sleeping outside Memorial Hall; no disturbances reported. Continued patrols towards Lorne Street.

Completed patrol of Lorne Street; all clear. Welfare check at Radisson RED Hotel, no concerns identified. Remained on standby outside the hotel maintaining a visible security presence; city activity very quiet, personnel remaining vigilant.
Radisson RED Hotel and surrounding area remained clear with no incidents reported. Continued patrols towards Wellesley Street.
Completed patrol of Wellesley Street; all clear, no issues reported.
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street; all clear with no concerns reported. Remained on standby maintaining a visible security presence.
McDonald's Queen Street experiencing high customer activity; no disturbances or issues reported by staff. Departed the area and returned towards HQ to charge the Ops Phone and take a break.
Night shift concluded; handover to the incoming shift completed successfully.

flags: CAPACITY: 13:33 urgent welfare call (possible suicide risk, 147 Quay Street) attended at 13:55 — the team was on lunch break at HQ when it came in; the female was not located after an area search.
SENSITIVE: 13:33 welfare response regarding a distressed young female and possible suicide risk; POI not found.
SENSITIVE: 18:39 Moona Store (MidCity) — male vagrant allegedly made racially abusive comments towards staff; gone on arrival, later intercepted twice (19:27, 19:39).
SENSITIVE: 19:39 person search conducted outside Foot Locker for suspected stolen merchandise; no stolen items found.
QA: Night shift deployed 22:49 and held at HQ until 00:09 charging the Ops Phone (3%) — no street patrols for the first ~100 minutes of the shift; no calls were missed during this period.
